frequency_question: How often do central banks successfully complete the operational rollout of a secondary reserve ratio instrument within a 4-to-5 month window following initial administrative preparation?
membership_rule: Includes any formal secondary reserve ratio or incremental liquidity absorption instrument introduction by a major central bank; excludes permanent structural changes to baseline reserve requirements.

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major instances named; represents core emerging market central bank liquidity instrument deployments.
known_gaps: Excludes minor technical adjustments not formally designated as secondary or incremental ratio tools.
skeleton: Central bank operational deployments of targeted liquidity control mechanisms within short mandated windows, evaluated across 5 recorded instances.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 5 documented instances of announced operational rollouts where time permitted.
validity_reason: Central bank operational frameworks for reserve management change slowly and remain stable across multi-year horizons.
